ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)
protocol_type: Host-mastered command-response protocol on the CMD line (48 bits) plus block-oriented data on the DAT line(s). Card commands are indexed CMD0..CMD63; application-specific commands ACMD* are prefixed by CMD55.

response_classes.name: R1
response_classes.content: Normal response; carries 32-bit Card Status (CSR) plus CRC7.

response_classes.name: R1b
response_classes.content: R1 followed by optional busy on DAT0 (LOW = busy).

response_classes.name: R2
response_classes.content: Carries CID (CMD2/CMD10) or CSD (CMD9); CRC is the register's internal CRC7, not the command CRC.

response_classes.name: R3
response_classes.content: Carries OCR (CMD58 in SPI / response to ACMD41); CRC field is all 1s (no CRC check).

response_classes.name: R6
response_classes.content: Published Relative Card Address response to CMD3; argument upper 16 bits = RCA, lower 16 bits = card status bits 23, 22, 19, 12:0.

response_classes.name: R7
response_classes.content: Response to CMD8 (SEND_IF_COND); echoes voltage accepted + check pattern.

data_block_format.data_start_bit: Single LOW bit on each active DAT line marking start of block.
data_block_format.payload: Default block length 512 bytes; CMD16 (SET_BLOCKLEN) sets payload size (SDSC). SDHC/SDXC block length is fixed at 512 B.
data_block_format.crc16: 16-bit CRC (polynomial x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1) per active DAT line, appended after payload.
data_block_format.data_end_bit: Single HIGH bit on each active DAT line marking end of block.
data_block_format.data_response_token_write: After each write block, card returns a Data Response Token on DAT0: xxx0SSS1 (SSS = 010 accept, 101 CRC error, 110 write error).

command_classes_ccc.name: basic
command_classes_ccc.commands_examples: CMD0, CMD2, CMD3, CMD7, CMD9, CMD10, CMD11, CMD12, CMD13, CMD15

command_classes_ccc.name: application specific
command_classes_ccc.commands_examples: CMD55, CMD56, ACMD6, ACMD13, ACMD22, ACMD23, ACMD41, ACMD42, ACMD51

channels.name: CLK
channels.description: Synchronous bus clock. Generated by host; 0-25 MHz Default Speed, 0-50 MHz High Speed, up to 208 MHz UHS-I SDR104.

channels.name: CMD
channels.description: Bidirectional command line. Open-drain during identification; push-pull thereafter. 48-bit frames.

channels.name: DAT0
channels.description: Data line 0. Used in 1-bit, 4-bit, and SPI modes (SPI: DO). Also signals busy when LOW during programming.

channels.name: DAT1
channels.description: Data line 1. Used in 4-bit mode. Doubles as IRQ line in SDIO.

channels.name: DAT2
channels.description: Data line 2. Used in 4-bit mode. Doubles as Read Wait in SDIO.

channels.name: DAT3
channels.description: Data line 3 in 4-bit SD mode; CS in SPI mode; CD/DAT3 (card detect) with optional pull-up controlled by ACMD42.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no VALID/READY handshake on the wire; framing is by Start/End bit + CRC.
Card-side flow control is by holding DAT0 LOW during programming / busy.
Host-side flow control (for write) is by withholding the next data block on DAT until the card-returned Data Response Token reports accept (010).

frame_format.data_frame: Start bit(s) + payload (default 512 B) + CRC16 per active DAT line + End bit(s).
